title: quick-fix silky french pineapple sauce
description: a quick and easy dessert sauce made with tropical pineapple and a hint of french flair, served warm over ice cream or pancakes. this silky sauce is perfect for a weeknight dessert or a special occasion.

ingredients.name: cornstarch
ingredients.notes: make sure to whisk out any lumps before cooking.

ingredients.name: large egg yolks
ingredients.notes: use just the yolks for a rich and creamy sauce.

ingredients.name: vanilla extract
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds a lovely flavor.

ingredients.name: unsalted chicken broth
ingredients.notes: adds moisture and a subtle flavor.

instructions: heat the butter in a ttukbaegi-earthenware cook over medium heat until melted.
whisk together the pineapple juice, sugar, and cornstarch until smooth.
add the egg yolks and whisk until well combined.
gradually add the heavy cream, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, or until thickened.
remove from heat and stir in the vanilla extract and salt.
strain the sauce through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean bowl.
stir in the chicken broth and whisk until smooth.
return the sauce to the earthenware cook and cook over low heat, whisking constantly, until the sauce coats the back of a spoon, about 5 minutes.
remove from heat and whisk in the unsalted butter until melted and smooth.
season with salt to taste, then serve warm over ice cream or pancakes.
serve immediately, garnished with fresh fruit or a sprinkle of powdered sugar, if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
